eyebrow: SQL for Oracle Financials · Chapter Six
subtitle: Lesson 26 · Practice Sets

eyebrow: "Which suppliers are we most exposed to?"
code:
SELECT s.vendor_name, SUM(ps.amount_remaining) AS total_outstanding
FROM poz_suppliers s
INNER JOIN ap_invoices_all i ON i.vendor_id = s.vendor_id
INNER JOIN ap_payment_schedules_all ps ON ps.invoice_id = i.invoice_id
WHERE ps.amount_remaining > 0
GROUP BY s.vendor_name
ORDER BY total_outstanding DESC
FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY;
caption: Join chain + GROUP BY/SUM + FETCH FIRST — three chapters in one query.

eyebrow: "Did we pay any invoice more than once?"
code:
SELECT i.invoice_num, i.invoice_amount, SUM(ip.amount) AS total_paid
FROM ap_invoices_all i
INNER JOIN ap_invoice_payments_all ip ON ip.invoice_id = i.invoice_id
GROUP BY i.invoice_num, i.invoice_amount
HAVING SUM(ip.amount) >= i.invoice_amount * 2;
caption: Threshold tuned to catch a suspected duplicate payment, not a minor overpayment.

eyebrow: "Any active suppliers missing a remit-to site?"
code:
SELECT DISTINCT s.vendor_name, i.invoice_num
FROM poz_suppliers s
INNER JOIN ap_invoices_all i ON i.vendor_id = s.vendor_id
WHERE i.vendor_site_id IS NULL;
caption: A data gap that can block payment processing entirely.
